contract_text: This Master Services Agreement is entered into between Acme Corp and Beta Industries effective on January 15, 2025. The initial term is twelve months. The contract renewal date is January 15, 2026. Annual fees of USD 48,000 are payable quarterly. Either party may terminate with 60 days written notice.

This Subscription Agreement between Gamma Health LLC and Delta Cloud Services begins on March 1, 2025. The renewal date is March 1, 2026 and renewal will occur automatically unless either party provides notice. The total annual fee is $120,000 with payment terms of net 30.

Service Agreement between Epsilon Logistics and Zeta Software effective from June 30, 2025. Renewal date: 2026-06-30. The agreement covers logistics planning software at a fee of EUR 75,000 per year. A 12% discount applies if paid annually in advance.

Master Agreement signed between Theta Bank and Iota Analytics on September 1, 2024. The contract renewal date falls on September 1, 2027 reflecting the agreed three-year term. Annual fees of GBP 250,000 are payable in two equal installments.

This Statement of Work is entered into between Kappa Retail and Lambda Consulting beginning October 15, 2025. The renewal date is October 15, 2026. Total project fee is $85,500. Lambda Consulting may be reached at contracts@lambda-consulting.example.
